profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at eMoney Advisor
profile.summary:
20+ years of software development experience in various industries
Strong background in Microsoft .NET development using C# (Web/Windows applications)
Strong analytical troubleshooting and debugging skills
Strong interpersonal and communication skills

Technical Skills

Programming Languages: C#, C, C++, Java, PHP (LAMP), Pascal, Shell Script, Angular
Proficient in ASP.NET, .NET Core, MVC, Entity Framework, Web API, REST API, PowerShell, Microsoft SQL Server 2016, JQuery, Microsoft SharePoint, JavaScript, NodeJS, Typescript, CSS, SASS, HTML, XML, AJAX, SQL Script, Web Service, JSON, IIS
Development Environment: Microsoft Visual Studio 2019, Microsoft Code, Zend Studio for Php, Eclipse for Java, SQL Server Management Studio
Databases: Microsoft SQL Server 2019, MySQL, Oracle
Other Software: ReSharper, dotTrace, Drupal, NET Reflector, Pro/ENGINEER, SolidWorks, VersionOne, Fiddler, InnoSetup (installer), Attunity RepliWeb (data distribution), Confluence, JIRA, SourceTree
Source Code Management: Git, BitBucket, Perforce, IBM Rational ClearCase, Microsoft Visual SourceSafe, Accurev
Cloud: Microsoft Azure

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Entity Framework · .NET Core · SQL · Transact-SQL (T-SQL) · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Git · ASP.NET Core · Front-End Development · ASP.NET MVC

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Senior developer of editorial engineering team for developing in-house applications focused in using Microsoft .NET and Core.

* Responsible for design and development of in-house applications enhancing editorial platform using .NET, .NET Core in C#, ASP.NET, Windows Service, MVC Core, VSTO, Visual Studio 2019, SQL Server 2016 and Visual Source Code.
* Regularly contribute in backlog reviews, prioritization, estimation, sprint planning, design/code reviews, unit tests, refactoring, demos and integration tests.
* Developed an editorial publishing application in Microsoft VSTO and responsible for continuous content publishing from Windows Server to Linux servers in 5 server farms across the globe using Attunity RepliWeb API, Windows Service, WCF.
* Actively participated in in-house SPA for content management using Angular, NodeJS, Typescript, C# and Web API.
positions.insights: Skills: Entity Framework · Microsoft Azure · .NET Core · SQL · Transact-SQL (T-SQL) · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Git · ASP.NET Core · Front-End Development · ASP.NET MVC

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Responsible for developing Windchill ProductPoint (data management) platform components using Microsoft .NET, C#, ASP.NET, SharePoint 2010, Visual Studio 2010, MVP design pattern.
* Contributed in backlog reviews, iteration planning, detailed estimation, design brainstorming and reviews, code reviews, demos and retrospectives.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Played active role in deploying games “Dungeons and Dragons Online” and “The Lord of the Rings Online”.
* Designed and developed game status server that manages game client traffics and game updates over 60,000 clients concurrently. (.NET WCF C#)
* Developed the game launcher (patch/upgrade, authentication/authorization and subscription management) for online users (C# .NET Framework 1.1/2.0, API)
* Developed the billing application for authentication and credit card transaction management, game subscriptions and user account management. (PHP, ASP.NET, AJAX, Total-E, MySQL)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Developed and managed web-based or standalone applications for in-house tools, intranets and external websites using ASP.NET C# and SQL Server.
* Developed CMS (Content Management System) in PHP for managing multiple websites concurrently using Microsoft SQL Server 2000.
* Developed corporate intranet in ASP.NET C# for handling internal documents and forms using Windows Active Directory and payroll information by ADP API.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
* Actively contributed the analysis, design, architecture, development, review, testing, documentation, and deployment of web-based applications.
* Designed and developed the user interface and contributed to the backend of a multi-language client/server application used to create web-based registration forms and to report on data collected via the forms in Tomcat/Apache using JSP and Java Servlet.
* Developed a database connection manager for maintaining persistent database connection pool to multiple Oracle databases in JDBC

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Developed 3-D CAD/CAM software (Pro/ENGINEER) in C/C++ for multi-platforms
* Performed regression, retrieval, and version-compatibility tests and performance analysis and tuning.
positions.insights: Skills: C (Programming Language) · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Computer-Aided Design (CAD)
